tagline: Journey through the land of the Pharaohs

hero.title: Where Time Meets the Eternal Desert
hero.subtitle: Follow the path of pharaohs and explorers through sacred tombs, golden dunes, and the timeless Nile.

discover.title: A Civilisation That Shaped the World
discover.p1: For over seven millennia, the banks of the Nile have witnessed one of humanity's greatest civilisations — a land where monumental stone pyramids rise from golden dunes and gods were carved into eternity.
discover.p2: From the bustling streets of Cairo to the silent majesty of the Valley of the Kings, Egypt is not merely a destination. It is a journey through time itself.
discover.p3: Our experts have crafted intimate journeys through this timeless land, balancing grand monuments with hidden corners few have seen.
discover.quote: Egypt is the gift of the Nile.

heritage.title: Treasures of a Timeless Civilisation
heritage.subtitle: A museum of living history — every artefact a whisper from an age of gods and kings.
heritage.p1: The golden mask of Tutankhamun, the Rosetta Stone's silent script, the towering Colossi of Memnon — each object is a chapter in the greatest story ever told.
heritage.p2: Our journeys bring you face to face with these wonders, guided by Egyptologists who breathe life into ancient stone.

about.title: About SunSet Tours Egypt
about.p1: We design coastal itineraries across Egypt’s Red Sea with a focus on clarity: honest pricing, bilingual storytelling, and responsive support.
about.p2: Our team blends local insight with a premium, minimal aesthetic — so planning feels calm, not chaotic.
about.p3: Whether you crave Sharm’s energy, Hurghada’s variety, or Marsa Alam’s serenity, we help you land on the right package.
